descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S20 Existing spec: a failed billing call shows an error with retry, and the retry saves the suggestion

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U15 If the billing call fails, the call is retried automatically, the note is still shown and the billing area shows a clear error with a way to retry; … (UAT Empty & Failure States (Billing suggestion failed); UAT 3.5; TFA-94745 AC 4)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital patient with a generated SOAP note; the first billing call is made to fail at the Convex socket

When Open Post-Round, tap the retry control

Then The billing area shows 'Couldn’t generate billing suggestion — tap to retry'; the retry shows and saves the suggestion for that note

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in billing-suggestion.spec.ts (retry visible, two calls, saved billingForNoteAt). Not asserted by this spec: the note staying visible and the automatic retry before the error (TFA-94745 AC 4) - both are in the Empty & Failure States matrix

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-18 Billing Suggestion · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-18/S20

Existing spec: a failed billing call shows an error with retry, and the retry saves the suggestion

Tickets: TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-18.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • billing-suggestion.spec.ts [chromium] — a failed suggestion stays visible and retries on tap — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright spec billing-suggestion.spec.ts, chromium): it seeds through the local admin key and fails the first suggestBilling call at the Convex socket (a mocked failure); dev has no admin key and the runner injects no fault there, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
